data: Which line has the lowest value at the start of training?

The green line represents Reinforce, which starts at approximately -6 on the y-axis. The other lines (Imitation, Imitation+Gaussian-RL, and Proposed) start at values closer to -4. Therefore, the green line has the lowest value at the start of training.
Final Answer: Reinforce
